visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular male host wearing a black tank top and yellow smartwatch sits in a bright room with indoor plants, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) Quick cuts show him performing bicep curls with dumbbells followed by a close-up of him in a kitchen environment. (3) He introduces a sleek black blender on a wooden table, adding a banana, blueberries, oats, and protein powder into the clear mixing jar. (4) Footage of a man performing high-intensity calisthenics on outdoor bars at night is intercut with close-ups of the blender's rotating metal blades and the smooth brown liquid being mixed. (5) The host is seen drinking the finished shake through a straw in a gym setting and then in the kitchen, appearing satisfied with the taste. (6) In a darker evening setting, he prepares another drink with sesame and milk, showcasing a smaller cup size. (7) The video concludes with the host holding the blender bottle, pointing to the product logo as high-energy graphics appear.
